data.name: label85.Text
data.value: ABC Institute is the largest, private sector, higher education network in Sri Lanka with 40 centers island-wide, ABC Institute has created opportunities for over 30,000 students every year. The ABC Institute consist of libraries within all the branches island wide where the professors,lectures and the students of each branch borrow books, return books and view the available books using a conventional library management process done manually. So, as a step-up we providing this Online Library Management System to library members for make up the functionalities such as online book reserving, book availability check and update profile details. Feel free to use this software.
